title: Leaked documents detail ECHOTRIBBLE, a nascent US Army Cyber Command program for agentic AI to autonomously spread across networks to find and eliminate targets (Sam Biddle/The Intercept)
summary: Sam Biddle / The Intercept: Leaked documents detail ECHOTRIBBLE, a nascent US Army Cyber Command program for agentic AI to autonomously spread across networks to find and eliminate targets — Documents obtained by The Intercept show the military is trying to deploy autonomous AI agents to hack its adversaries.
